SD50-CP03.name: Idol Activity!
SD50-CP03.effect:
[Type: Song]

[Main]
Reveal five cards from your decktop. Besides "Idol Activity!", add an "Idol" family card among them to your Hand. Return any remaining "Idol" family cards to the decktop, and banish the rest.

[Flash]
During this turn, give an "Idol" family Spirit you control +2000 BP.

SD50-CP01.name: Johnny Bepp
SD50-CP01.effect:
[Grandwalker Nexus]
This Nexus can only be affected by effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses. Cores can only be placed on this Nexus via Core Charge or effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses, and cannot be moved from this Nexus except via effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Core Charge: (Idol & Cost 3 or more)]
◆When you Summon/Advent a target Spirit, you can put a core from the Void onto this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you don't control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, put a core from the Void onto this Nexus.

[Grand Field] [LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
When your "Idol" & "School Style" family Spirit is summoned, if your Hand is five or less, draw a card. This effect doesn't stack.

[Grand Skill: 2] [LV2] (Your Main Step)
(Send two cores from this Nexus to the Void) During this turn, treat one "Idol" family Spirit you control as being one level higher.

SD50-CP02.name: Mitsuishi Orihime
SD50-CP02.effect:
[GPGWrule]

[Core Charge: (Idol & Cost 3 or more)]
◆When you Summon/Advent a target Spirit, you can put a core from the Void onto this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you do not control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, put a core from the Void onto this Nexus.

5 [LV1][LV2] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
(Send five cores from this Nexus to the Void) Refresh all "Idol" family Spirits you control, and during this turn, this Nexus is also treated as a Spirit with [LV1][LV2] 3000 BP, and can only be destroyed by Grandwalker Nexuses. This effect can only be used once per game.

[Grand Skill: 2] [LV2] Flash - (Opposing Attack Step)
(Send two cores from this Nexus to the Void) Refresh a "Stage Style" family Spirit you control.

SD50-CP04.effect:
[Type: Song]

This card has "Idol" family.

During your Start Step, by paying two costs, return this card from the Trash to your Hand. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[Flash]
During this turn, give an opposing Spirit -7000 BP. When this effect brought its BP to 0, you can return it to the Hand.
